original_gate: Preserve all 19 columns, both within-cell repeats and exact historical PASS reference from R4B5A.3a. No retrospective relaxation. R4B5A.4 failed AMD array is a diagnostic comparator, not baseline acceptance reference. Actual CPU of current VM must be read, not assumed Intel.

decisions.all_equal: no observed effect of requested threads in {1,2} on tested VM
decisions.numba_only: N1B1=N1B2 != N2B1=N2B2; Numba factor-associated effect in tested environment
decisions.other_patterns: joint dependence or interaction candidate; four different hashes alone do not establish interaction on numerical scale; report pairwise differences, repeatability and unresolved mechanism

near_zero: all mismatch points classified using both magnitudes <1e-30; do not exclude any historical exact gate even if zero transitions; separate prospective numerical equivalence protocol necessary for alternative gate
ulp: 8 ULP and 2e-15 only prospective diagnostic limits in R4B5A.4c, not retrospective R4B5A.4 acceptance
subcell: diagnostic only; previously passed native full profile error gate does not require sampled peak exactly equal .9; smooth isolated analytic peak has quadratic sampling value error, not necessarily monotone location error
cross_architecture_hold: OPEN independent of thread factorial outcome. Historical AMD EPYC 9V74 versus Intel Xeon 6975P-C and unset versus one-thread settings confounded. Future matched CPU comparison required; do not claim historical reference CPU without evidence.

future_cross_architecture.design: Separate precommit: same exact software, thread counts N1B1, independent cold caches and two repeats per CPU family; record actual model, flags, dispatch, library hashes, image and manifests; compare within CPU first then between CPU. Prefer same pinned OCI digest plus controlled ISA/compiler target when possible. Hosted runner labels do not guarantee CPU vendor; if requested CPU unavailable report NOT_TESTED, never relabel another CPU. Cross-family mismatch shows platform-associated effect, not isolated microarchitectural causality; CPU/dispatch interaction needs controlled experiment.
